name: Gudeng Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan, Gudeng Equipment Co., LTD specializes in the development and sale of automated technological solutions for the transfer and handling of photomasks. Their product offerings include EUV mask cleaning systems, sophisticated high-end photomask delivery mechanisms, and PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition) equipment technology solutions.
